title: school.registered (v1)
description: tenant -> school, topic school.registered, key school_id. Written to the tenant outbox in the same transaction as the registry row (spec §06, «Реєстрація й перший вхід»); school-service creates an empty school profile and an audit entry «заклад зареєстровано». No personal data: the scheduler's login and temporary password never leave tenant-service.

school_id.description: Same value as the envelope school_id (the partition key).

name.description: School name as registered by the sysadmin, trimmed. school-service shows it in the profile and does not let the scheduler change it.

registered_at.description: When the school was registered; equals the envelope time.
